reason: Independent customer-shaped module: import-free non-main root packages with one non-constant concat (buildinfo), slicing only (textutil) or []byte->string only (bconv) make the pinned weaver panic 'assignment to entry in nil map' at oncompile.go:195 on go1.26.6 and on go1.27.0+nojsonv2, with DD_IAST_ENABLED unset. The app binary importing them fails too. Adding one import fixes it, and woven output is identical to plain. Cause: importcfg.parse leaves PackageFile nil when there are no packagefile lines, and oncompile.go:195 writes to it unguarded (also unfixed in orchestrion origin/main and v1.13.0 at :212). Same root cause as hooks-yml-operators-F3. Minor correction: only []byte->string conversions trigger it (string->[]byte is not instrumented), and import-free package main did not crash.
